# JUST EXAM - OGE/EGE English Exam Preparation

> Comprehensive English exam preparation platform specializing in OGE and EGE test coaching through online courses, Skype tutoring, and self-study materials led by teacher Anna Zhilina.

JUST EXAM (zhilina-english.ru) is a Russian online English education service focused on helping students prepare for the OGE (основной государственный экзамен) and EGE (единый государственный экзамен) standardized exams. The platform offers both self-paced online courses and personalized Skype tutoring with experienced instructor Anna Zhilina.

## Key Topics

- OGE (основной государственный экзамен)
- EGE (единый государственный экзамен)
- English exam preparation
- Speaking section (говорение)
- Listening section (аудирование)
- Skype tutoring
- Online self-study courses
- Monologue task (монолог)
- Telephone interview (телефонный опрос)
- Anna Zhilina (teacher)
- FIPИ exam standards
- Grammar and vocabulary
- Exam scoring and structure
- Student reviews and testimonials
- Individual lessons

## Core Exam Preparation

- [OGE/EGE JUST EXAM - Homepage](https://zhilina-english.ru): Main portal for JUST EXAM exam prep service featuring OGE/EGE English courses and tutoring options
- [EGE English - 100 Points Preparation](https://zhilina-english.ru/ege): EGE English exam preparation materials and strategies for achieving 100-point results
- [OGE/EGE Online Courses](https://zhilina-english.ru/kursyi): Comprehensive online courses for OGE/EGE English exam preparation with sample answers and practice materials
- [Telephone Interview Task 2 Course](http://zhilina-english.ru/kursyi/telefonnyj-opros-oge): Specialized online course for OGE telephone interview task 2 preparation
- [Ideal Monologue OGE Course](http://zhilina-english.ru/kursyi/idealnyiy-monolog): Online self-study course focused on perfecting OGE English monologue task responses

## Exam Structure & Speaking Tasks

- [OGE English: Structure and Scoring](http://zhilina-english.ru/yazyiku-v-201gia-v-formate-oge-po-angliyskomu-yazyiku-5-godu): OGE English exam structure, scoring system, and grade conversion guide
- [OGE Speaking Section Changes 2016](http://zhilina-english.ru/gia-govorenie-speaking-2016-novaya-versiya): OGE speaking section changes, task types, and assessment criteria
- [OGE Oral Part - Task 2 Sample Answers](http://zhilina-english.ru/ustnaya-chast-oge-primeryi-otvetov-na-zadanie-2): Sample answers for OGE oral exam task 2 with detailed teacher commentary
- [OGE Monologue Examples - Task 3](http://zhilina-english.ru/ustnaya-chast-oge-angliyskiy-yazyik-primer-monologa): Sample monologue answers for OGE task 3 with teacher analysis and scoring explanation
- [OGE Listening Section Strategies](http://zhilina-english.ru/gia-audirovanie): OGE English listening section strategies and task execution tactics for success
